name: get_resources
description: Get Resources not in a Folder

limit.description: Limit of records to be retrieved

after.description: id of the first record BEFORE the events you want to retrieve

filter[type].description: The type of event you want to retrieve; examples include `birthday`, `announcement`, `recent_arrival` or `anniversary`

profile_id.description: id of the profile that you wish to pull all associated events from

order.description: This parameter allows you to change how results are ordered. Valid values are `asc` and `desc` - It defaults to `desc`

page.description: the page of information you'd like to receive.

per_page.description: the number of employees to retrieve when using pagination; default is 30 and the limit is 50.

page.description: the page of information you'd like to receive.

per_page.description: the number of employees to retrieve when using pagination; default is 30 and the limit is 50.

profile_format.description: format of the profile object; only short is supported - returns a truncated version of the profile object

sort.description: sort order of profiles; valid values - first_name, last_name, created_at, updated_at; prepend with a - (minus) sign to reverse the order

filter[first_name].description: returns only profiles with the defined first name

filter[last_name].description: returns only profiles with the defined last name

filter[email].description: returns only profiles with the defined (company) email

filter[personal_email].description: returns only profiles with the defined personal email

filter[job_title].description: returns only profiles with the defined job title; must be the job_title's title

filter[reports_to].description: id of the profile for whose direct reports you to view; returns only those profiles

filter[user_status].description: returns only profiles with the defined user_status; active, pending, and inactive are supported
